input.subject: Failed Samsung Payment
input.body: Good morning, my transaction failed while I was ordering a Samsung monitor. The order was not placed, but the payment amount has not been refunded yet. The transaction ID is 72384982, and the payment was made through Kotak Bank. Could you please check the transaction and provide an update on my refund?
